· RSI 궤적 (49.9→50.9) + 과매수/과매도/중립 판단: 중립 구간 지속, 방향성 부재.
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (2033.8340→468.3919) + 개선/악화 진단: 크게 악화, 약세 전환 신호.

[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 (94,590원) + 근거: 피벗 S1(95,792원) 및 20일 저가(94,430원) 기반, 심리적 지지선.
· 스윙 저항선 (115,010원) + 돌파 시 의미: 볼린저밴드 상단(116,492원)과 인접, 단기 저항 구간.
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보) + 추세 해석: 5일 고가 110,435원, 20일 고가 120,015원. 5일 저가 98,695원, 20일 저가 94,430원. 뚜렷한 Higher Low 또는 Lower High 패턴 미형성, 횡보 국면.
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.92배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 판단: 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.92로 정상 수준, 움직임의 신뢰도 보통.
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 진입·관망 조건 명시: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 중립, MACD 약화, ADX 무추세로 방향성 부재. 115,010원 저항 돌파 시 매수 고려, 94,590원 지지 이탈 시 매도 고려.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($109,265) vs SMA5($103,624)/SMA20($106,679)/SMA50($108,051): Short/Mid-term trend position diagnosis: Above SMA5, SMA20, SMA50, indicating mid-term trend strength.
· Position vs SMA100($142,418)/SMA200($106,937): Mid/Long-term trend strength assessment: Below SMA100, above SMA200, mixed mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-Week Position(36.0%) + Historical significance of current price range: High relative to 52-week low but low relative to high, near the middle of the trading range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (49.9→50.9) + Overbought/Oversold/Neutral assessment: Neutral range continuation, lack of directional momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (2033.8340→468.3919) + Improvement/Deterioration diagnosis: Significantly worsened, signaling a bearish turn.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-Band $106,679) + Bandwidth level interpretation: Sideways movement around the mid-band, bandwidth at 18.40% indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($94,590) + Basis: Based on Pivot S1($95,792) and 20-day low($94,430), psychological support level.
· Swing Resistance ($115,010) + Significance of breakout: Adjacent to the upper Bollinger Band($116,492), short-term resistance zone.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) + Trend interpretation: 5-day high $110,435, 20-day high $120,015. 5-day low $98,695, 20-day low $94,430. No clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed, indicating a sideways phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.92x) + Movement reliability assessment: Volume ratio at 0.92 relative to 5-day average, indicating normal levels and moderate reliability of movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation) + Entry/Wait-and-see conditions: Wait-and-see maintained for three consecutive sessions. Neutral RSI, weakening MACD, and trendless ADX indicate a lack of direction. Consider buying on a breakout above $115,010, and selling on a break below the support at $94,590.
